title: Amazing Aromatic Filipino Tofu Casserole
description: A yeast-based, molten Filipino dish featuring brandy and lacquer glaze, perfect for vegetarians, this casserole is a crowd-pleaser with its savory and slightly sweet flavors.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
In a large bowl, whisk together the yeast extract, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cubed tofu to the bowl and toss to coat with the yeast mixture.
Add the cooked onion and garlic to the bowl and stir to combine.
In a small bowl, whisk together the brandy and lacquer glaze.
Pour the brandy and lacquer glaze mixture over the tofu mixture and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake for 35 minutes.
